Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year detailed tables (B01001, B01002, B01003, B03002, B08013, B08301, B11001, B19013, B25003, B25044, B25046, C17002) via api.census.gov. Boundaries: Census TIGERweb (2020-based tracts and block groups, used through the 2025–2029 release), simplified for display.

Colors and percentiles always compare against every area of the same type in Texas, so a tract’s color means the same thing in any county. Natural breaks are computed from an evenly spaced sample of up to 1,500 values.

Estimates carry margins of error that grow large for tracts and especially block groups; treat small-area differences with care. Mean travel time excludes people who work from home. Density uses land area only.
